title: Standard API Error Response
description: Canonical shape for the JSON body of any 4xx or 5xx HTTP response across platform microservices. See openspec/specs/api-error-responses/spec.md for the normative requirements.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier. Must not change when `message` text changes.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error. May change wording without being a breaking change.

traceId.description: Identifier correlating this response to server-side logs/tracing.

details.description: Field-level validation issues. Present for validation-style errors (typically 400/422).

field.description: camelCase name of the offending field.
